title: How to AirPlay from iPhone or MacBook to your TV - Engadget
summary: For screen mirroring from a MacBook, tap the Control Center icon in the top right of your MacBook menu bar (it looks like two overlapping toggle switches) and select the Screen Mirroring icon.
